summary: Gone Alleghany County, Virginia, lookout listed under Peters Mountain. No source describes it; Hanging Rock, a different tower, is on the same mountain in West Virginia.

evidence.supports: Alleghany County record named Peters Mountain, type Unknown, status Gone, at the stated coordinates
Peters Mountain is a 52-mile (84 km) mountain on the border of Alleghany and Monroe counties and two more Virginia counties
evidence.quote: Peters Mountain is a 52-mile (84 km) mountain in the U.S. states of Virginia and West Virginia.

evidence.supports: the mountain lies on the border of Alleghany County, Monroe County, Giles County and Craig County
evidence.quote: It is located on the border between Alleghany County, VA , Monroe County, WV , Giles Co., VA , and Craig Co., VA .

evidence.supports: Hanging Rock listed in Monroe County, West Virginia, at 37.50448 -80.45302
evidence.quote: Monroe Hanging Rock 37.50448 -80.45302 Ground Standing NHLR US 581, WV 7

evidence.supports: Hanging Rock tower last used for fire detection in 1972
evidence.quote: 1972: This was the last year the lookout was used for fire detection.

evidence.supports: Hanging Rock tower stood on Peters Mountain and was destroyed by fire on Feb. 10, 1996 (per a March 1996 report)
evidence.quote: A Feb. 10 blaze destroyed the tower on Peters Mountain in the George Washington-Jefferson National Forest.

evidence.supports: fire destroyed the Hanging Rock tower in February 1996 (report dated February 11, 1996)
evidence.quote: A Monroe County landmark was destroyed by fire Saturday evening, leaving only a pile of ashes where the Hanging Rock Fire Tower once stood.

notes_for_editor: The Virginia record has no source beyond the association list. The West Virginia list also has a separate Monroe County record named Peters Mountain (type Unknown, status Gone), so the name is shared across two states and the record may be confused with either. The story keeps the Hanging Rock tower out of the Virginia lookout's history and only distinguishes it by location. Whether the Alleghany record is a real lookout site is unverified. The WV list codes Hanging Rock as Standing, while the Forest Lookouts page reports the tower was destroyed by fire in February 1996; the story gives no current status for it.
